before_metrics.comment: exp-20260525-034 watchlist had eps_estimate_delta_30d null for all 700 rows; estimate_revision_ledger stored the 30d field null across the watchlist window.

change_summary: Builds a PIT-safe per-ticker eps_estimate timeline from data/daily/snapshots/earnings/earnings_snapshot_*.json and derives eps_estimate_delta_30d (absolute) and eps_estimate_pct_delta_30d for each exp-20260525-034 watchlist row. Current leg = latest snapshot <= as_of_date; prior leg = latest snapshot <= as_of_date - 30 calendar days. Pct delta is None when abs(prior) < 0.05 to avoid near-zero-denominator noise. Writes enriched artifact to data/experiments/exp-20260528-030/; does not modify exp-20260525-034.
decision_rule: Gate 4: at least 80 pct of primary positive rows must obtain a non-null eps_estimate_delta_30d (absolute) value.

gate_questions.what_hypothesis: eps_estimate_delta_30d can be reconstructed PIT-safely from earnings_snapshot files, unblocking the revision-magnitude alpha branch.
gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260527-002 closed observed_only_data_gap citing eps_estimate_delta_30d 0pct coverage and 7d 55pct coverage; exp-20260527-908 unblocked last_earnings_date from a parallel snapshot source.
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: eps_estimate_delta_30d PIT join into expectation revision watchlist row.
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: Gate 4: >= 80 pct of primary positive rows resolve a non-null 30d delta.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Single deterministic script over checked-in snapshot data; no live API calls; 11 unit tests cover PIT safety, latest-on-or-before semantics, pct floor, and gate logic.

hypothesis: eps_estimate_delta_30d can be reconstructed PIT-safely from the same earnings_snapshot_*.json files that already feed the estimate_revision_ledger by looking up eps_estimate at as_of_date and at the most recent snapshot dated <= as_of_date - 30 calendar days. This unblocks the expectation revision magnitude alpha line (exp-20260527-002).
next_evidence_needed: Re-run exp-20260527-002 against the enriched watchlist to test the revision-magnitude hypothesis with both 7d and 30d axes. The 9 unresolved primary positive rows (RBLX, COHR, SOFI, MTSI) are recent additions to the snapshot universe and will self-heal as snapshot history deepens. revenue_estimate and analyst_count velocity remain absent and are the next magnitude-axis measurement repair.
single_causal_variable: eps_estimate_delta_30d PIT join into expectation revision watchlist row
